pages.title: Predator and Prey
pages.text: $(thing)Predator and Prey$()$(br2)More prey feed more predators, more predators eat more prey, and so it cycles, round and round. Unlocks Stable Ecosystems and the Symbiont Lining.

$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Ecology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Algae Culture, 2 Bacterial Culture.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Prey settle at the level where predators neither grow nor shrink: predator death g against gain d per prey. Write that prey level X.
